body:
Found while auditing every compositor-property animation in `frontend/src/` (the
SVG-target compositing sweep, PR fix/spa-svg-animation-main-thread).

Six modules run an infinite `transform: rotate(360deg)` spinner. Four of them
switch it off under `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`:

- `frontend/src/components/HelpBanner.module.css` — `.arrow`, `.banner`
- `frontend/src/components/DiscoverSection.module.css` — `.spin`
- `frontend/src/pages/Catalog.module.css` — `.refreshIconSpin`
- `frontend/src/pages/CoverPicker.module.css` — `.spin`
- `frontend/src/pages/Duplicates.module.css` — `.spinning`

Two do not:

- `frontend/src/pages/Reader.module.css` — `.spin` (`spin 0.9s linear infinite`)
- `frontend/src/pages/Upload.module.css` — `.spin` (`spin 0.9s linear infinite`)

OBSERVED 2026-08-18 by walking the live CSSOM in Chrome over the built
stylesheet: the six `prefers-reduced-motion` rules present are `_banner_*`,
`_arrow_*`, DiscoverSection `_spin_*`, `_refreshIconSpin_*`, CoverPicker
`_spin_*` and `_spinning_*`. Reader's and Upload's `.spin` are absent.

Not fixed in that PR on purpose: whether a *loading* spinner should stop under
reduced-motion is a product call, not a mechanical one (a still spinner conveys
less state), and the PR is a perf change that must not smuggle in a behaviour
change. But the fork is currently inconsistent with itself in both directions,
which is the part that is certainly wrong. Pick one rule and apply it to all
six.
title: SPA loading spinners in Reader and Upload ignore prefers-reduced-motion
